info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: The Cancel Airline Flight API allows users to process cancellations for scheduled airline flights. This endpoint is designed for airline operators and travel agencies seeking to manage flight schedules efficiently. By submitting a request to this API, consumers can remove specific flight information, ensuring real-time updates to available services. Common use cases include handling customer cancellations or adjustments to flight itineraries, promoting a seamless travel experience. This functionality supports airlines in maintaining accurate operational data.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an existing flight reservation. Make sure to have the flight ID and necessary permissions to perform this action.
